tasks.title: Youth sports clubs: priorities
tasks.instruction:
You must answer this question. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

In your English class you have been talking about youth sports clubs. Now your English teacher has asked you to write an essay.

Write an essay using all the notes and giving reasons for your point of view.

What is the most important issue facing youth sports clubs today?

Notes

Write about:

1. cost of membership
2. availability of trained coaches
3. ......................... (your own idea)

tasks.title: Youth sports club review
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement in a specialist magazine for sports club organisers.

Reviews wanted

Have you attended a youth sports club recently? We want to hear about your experience.

Write a review of the club. Describe the facilities and coaching, say whether the club is good value for money, and recommend one improvement that would make it more accessible to young people.

The best reviews will be published in the next issue.

Write your review.

tasks.title: Making youth sports clubs more responsible
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You see this announcement on a youth sports programme coordinator's website.

Articles wanted

How can youth sports clubs encourage long-term responsibility in young members?

Write an article for the website. Suggest one practical way clubs can promote responsibility, explain why it would work, and describe the benefits for the club and the wider community.

We will publish the best articles on our website.

Write your article.

tasks.title: Youth sports club visit
tasks.instruction:
Answer one of these questions. Write 140–190 words in an appropriate style.

You have received this email from your English-speaking contact, Jamie.

From: Jamie
Subject: Youth sports club visit

Hi,
I'm planning to visit your town next month and would like to see a youth sports club in action. I'm interested in how clubs balance making sports accessible with teaching responsibility. Can you recommend a club I should visit? What do you think is the biggest challenge they face? Also, could you help arrange a visit?

Thanks,
Jamie

Write your email.
